name: pixelkin
description: PixelKin — a retro-styled creature-collecting adventure for the web (and, in time, mobile).

scripts.build:dist: npm run build && node tools/audio/compress_dist_audio.mjs && node tools/build/strip_sourcemaps.mjs
scripts.preview:release: npm run release && php -S localhost:8000 -t release
scripts.deploy: npm run release && python3 tools/deploy/ftp_deploy.py --scope both
scripts.deploy:site: npm run release:site && python3 tools/deploy/ftp_deploy.py --scope site
scripts.deploy:game: npm run release:game && python3 tools/deploy/ftp_deploy.py --scope game
